scope: Authenticated native HTTP answer against an actual two-branch dynamic-plan wait set, using AgentService, a synthetic model peer and xlang3-backed SQLite.
verified_behavior: Actual AgentService execution creates two concurrently waiting nested agents under one durable root pause.
The real native HTTP server returns both nested owners and their exact question IDs in one authenticated observation.
The same plan observation route rejects a request without bearer authentication.
A stale nested-plan state sequence returns HTTP 409 and leaves that question waiting.
A valid HTTP answer carries the selected nested plan's observed revision and state sequence; it resumes the root and preserves the unanswered sibling for its next pause.
The remaining request is explicitly selected and answered through the A2A task path; both original nested calls complete exactly once.
The combined Release contracts preserve repository restart/partial-resume coverage and CLI per-plan request routing.
limits: Provider and answer fixtures are synthetic; no live model/provider behavior is claimed.
This does not drive a full two-branch interactive CLI /watch session, rendered browser flow, or installed VS Code flow.
Concurrent HTTP answer races, cancellation races, expiry/uncertainty and repeated-segment budget/context exhaustion remain unverified.
